title: Rho-Bank Plus Members: Extended Introductory APR Period
content:
## Extended Introductory Period

- Customers with an active Rho-Bank Plus subscription receive a 15-month introductory APR period on new personal credit cards, instead of the standard 12 months.

## Agent Guidance

- The subscription appears on the customer's profile as rho_bank_plus_subscription.
- When applying or correcting an introductory APR for a Plus member, set the promotional APR expiration to 15 months after the account open date.
